propositions: A new read-only live test suite must exercise the S3 store backend and real Cloud ticket volume across REB and DIG projects without performing any Jira mutations.
The test suite must structurally enforce read-only access by monkeypatching all mutating AcliClient methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, etc.) to raise an exception.
The isolated S3-backed store uses a throwaway git-remote-s3 prefix as its only remote, deleted after test teardown, preventing access to production stores.
Inbound fetch via compute_snapshot and bridge_preview in DRY_RUN mode must correctly scope results per project (REB-only or DIG-only mappings), with zero cross-project contamination.
Unknown or non-existent mapped project keys must fail closed (raise an exception) during snapshot computation, never silently succeed.
Per-project Jira issue counts before and after bridge_preview execution must be identical to verify zero mutations occurred.
